name: maintainerkit
description: A read-only GitHub Action that turns repository activity into a maintainer digest and draft release notes.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/index.mjs --legal-comments=external --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "node:module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);'
